name: Société des Dattes d'El Oued (SDO)
activity_description: Major date processing and export company specializing in Deglet Nour dates from Touggourt oasis region. One of Algeria's largest date exporters with modern processing facilities.

name: Groupe Agro-Oasis Touggourt (GAOT)
activity_description: Leading agricultural group operating extensive palm groves in the Touggourt region. Integrates cultivation, harvesting, processing and export of premium dates.

name: Coopérative des Palmeraies de El M'Ghair (COPEM)
activity_description: Agricultural cooperative uniting over 500 date palm farmers in El M'Ghair region. Provides collective marketing, processing support and export facilitation for member producers.

name: Société Saharienne de Commerce et d'Industrie (SSCI)
activity_description: Major trading company in El Oued wilaya handling import-export operations, general commerce, agricultural products distribution and equipment supply for the Sahara region.

name: Dattes du Sud Export (DSE)
activity_description: Specialized date export company focusing on high-quality Deglet Nour from traditional oasis groves around Debila. Direct farm-to-market approach with organic options.

name: BTP El Oued Construction
activity_description: Construction company serving El Oued wilaya with expertise in residential, commercial and public infrastructure projects. Specializes in traditional dome architecture adaptation for modern buildings.

name: Société de Tourisme Oasien (STO)
activity_description: Tourism operator specializing in desert excursions, oasis visits and cultural tourism in the El Oued region. Offers packages featuring traditional architecture, palm grove tours and Sahara experiences.

name: Unité de Transformation des Produits Agricoles (UTPA)
activity_description: Agro-food processing facility producing value-added date products including paste, syrup, vinegar and confectionery ingredients. Supplies food industry across Algeria and exports to international markets.

name: Coopérative Artisanale des Tapis d'El Oued (CATEO)
activity_description: Artisanal cooperative preserving traditional carpet weaving heritage of El Oued region. Members produce hand-woven carpets, rugs and textiles using traditional patterns and techniques passed through generations.

name: Elevage Moderne Saharien (EMS)
activity_description: Modern livestock operation combining traditional Saharan pastoral practices with contemporary animal husbandry techniques. Specializes in sheep breeding, dairy production and fodder cultivation.

name: Société d'Exploitation des Phoénicicoles (SEP)
activity_description: Company specialized in date palm grove management, providing technical services including pollination, harvesting, pest management and grove rehabilitation for palm owners across El Oued wilaya.

name: Dattes & Délices d'Orient (DDO)
activity_description: Premium date brand specializing in gourmet date products for retail and gift markets. Offers luxury packaging, chocolate-covered dates, stuffed dates and confectionery items made with local dates.

name: Matériels Agricoles du Sud (MAS)
activity_description: Agricultural equipment supplier serving the El Oued region's farming community. Imports and distributes irrigation systems, farm machinery, greenhouse equipment and date processing machinery.

name: Transport Logistique Saharien (TLS)
activity_description: Logistics and transport company operating in the El Oued region with fleet serving local businesses, date exporters and cross-border trade routes to Libya and Tunisia.

name: Huilerie Moderne d'El Oued (HMEO)
activity_description: Modern oil pressing facility producing high-quality date seed oil, olive oil and other vegetable oils. Utilizes contemporary extraction technology while maintaining traditional quality standards.

name: Société Immobilière du Grand El Oued (SIGEO)
activity_description: Real estate development company involved in housing projects, commercial complexes and urban development in El Oued city and surrounding communes. Addresses growing urbanization needs of the wilaya.

name: Coopérative Laitière de Reguiba (CLR)
activity_description: Dairy cooperative collecting milk from local herders and producing fresh dairy products for regional consumption. Supports small-scale livestock keepers in the Reguiba area.

name: Pépinière des Palmiers du Sud (PPS)
activity_description: Date palm nursery producing quality offshoots and tissue-cultured plants. Specializes in disease-resistant varieties suited to Saharan conditions. Serves replanting programs across southern Algeria.

name: Entreprise Générale de Travaux Publics (EGTP-El Oued)
activity_description: General contractor executing public works projects including road infrastructure, water supply networks, sanitation systems and government building contracts across El Oued wilaya.

name: Société de Conditionnement des Dattes (SCD)
activity_description: Contract packaging company offering professional date packing services for producers and exporters. Modern facility with sorting, grading, vacuum-packing and labeling capabilities for various market requirements.

name: Agence de Voyages Oasis Sahara (AVOS)
activity_description: Travel agency organizing desert tourism packages, pilgrimage travel (Hajj/Umrah), domestic tourism and business travel services. Licensed operator with experienced guides familiar with Sahara terrain.

name: Société des Eaux Minérales d'El Oued (SEMEO)
activity_description: Bottled water company exploiting natural underground water sources in the El Oued region. Produces mineral water, sparkling water and large-format bottles for commercial and household consumption.

name: Atelier de Tapisserie Traditionnelle ATT-Touggourt
activity_description: Traditional carpet workshop in Touggourt producing authentic hand-woven rugs using ancestral techniques. Preserves distinctive Touggourt designs featuring geometric patterns inspired by oasis life and desert motifs.

name: Ferme Intégrée des Végétaux (FIV)
activity_description: Integrated farm practicing modern oasis agriculture combining date palms with vegetable crops, fruit trees and fodder production. Uses efficient irrigation and sustainable practices adapted to arid environment.

name: Société d'Électrosoudage et Métallerie (SEM-El Oued)
activity_description: Metal fabrication workshop serving industrial, construction and agricultural sectors. Produces custom metalwork, gates, fencing, storage tanks, irrigation pipe systems and structural steel components.

name: Commerce Général du Sud (CGS)
activity_description: Wholesale and retail trading company operating multiple outlets across El Oued wilaya. Handles general merchandise, food products, household goods and supplies smaller retailers throughout the region.

name: Station Service et Carburants Sahariens (SCS)
activity_description: Fuel distributor operating service stations across El Oued wilaya. Supplies gasoline, diesel, lubricants and fuel oil to vehicles, agricultural machinery and industrial customers in the region.

name: Laboratoire d'Analyses et Contrôle Qualité (LACQ)
activity_description: Testing laboratory providing quality control services for agricultural products, especially dates and food products. Offers microbiological testing, chemical analysis and certification support for exporters.

name: Société Froid et Climatisation du Sud (SFCS)
activity_description: HVAC company installing and servicing refrigeration systems, air conditioning units and cold storage facilities. Critical partner for date preservation requiring temperature-controlled environments.

name: Établissement Benyamina pour les Dattes (EBD)
activity_description: Family-owned date business established over three generations. Operates traditional palm groves near Touggourt producing premium hand-selected dates for discerning domestic and export markets.

name: Centre de Formation Professionnelle Agricole (CFPA-El Oued)
activity_description: Vocational training center providing agricultural education, date palm cultivation courses, food processing training and handicraft skills development for youth employment in the region.
